2016.title: Nigeria - Spatial Distribution of Population
2016.description: Estimates of 2016, total number of people per grid-cell. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are number of people per pixel. The mapping approach is Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution.More information can be found in the Release Statement. Disclaimer:The dataset currently represents an alpha version (R2025A) product and may change over the coming year as improvements are made.
